lead: About twenty nested parentheses already reach the parser's recursion limit, and a hostile case that trips it fails.
body: The limit is 96 levels and one parenthesised expression costs several, so `((((...))))` written to look extreme stops the program being read at all — which `tests/hostile/README.md` counts as a failure, because an attack that does not compile was never delivered. Keep a depth attack in a hostile file well under it, or build the nesting at run time out of values.
